# Frontline Data Solutions

> > Comprehensive EHS management software platform helping organizations streamline safety compliance, incident tracking, training, and operational risk management across industries.

Frontline Data Solutions provides an integrated suite of EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) software solutions designed to help organizations meet regulatory requirements and reduce workplace risks. The platform serves diverse industries including oil and gas, manufacturing, construction, food and beverage, and utilities.

## Key Topics

- EHS Management
- OSHA Compliance
- Incident Management
- Management of Change (MOC)
- Contractor Safety
- Safety Training
- Corrective Action Tracking
- Process Safety Management
- Regulatory Compliance
- Workflow Automation
- Risk Management
- Safety Documentation
- Compliance Reporting
- Hazmat Management
- Operational Risk Control

## EHS Software Modules

- [Management of Change Software | Frontline MOC for Risk Control](https://www.fldata.com/management-of-change-software): Frontline MOC product page for streamlined operational change management
- [Incident Management Software | Frontline ACT for Action Tracking](https://www.fldata.com/incident-management-software): Frontline ACT incident tracking and compliance reporting solution
- [Safety Learning Management Software | Frontline LMS](https://www.fldata.com/lms): Frontline LMS safety training and compliance management system
- [Contractor Safety Management Software | Frontline CSM](https://www.fldata.com/contractor-safety-management-software): Frontline CSM contractor onboarding and verification platform
- [Corrective Action Tracking Software | Frontline Data Solutions](https://www.fldata.com/corrective-action-software): Frontline ACT corrective action and audit tracking workflow automation
- [Process Safety Management Software | Frontline Data Solutions](https://www.fldata.com/process-safety-management-software): Frontline MOC OSHA 1910.119 process safety management compliance
